STEP 10. Check the torque converter clutch solenoid valve 
at solenoid valve assembly connector B-40.
(1) Disconnect connector B-40 and measure at the solenoid 
valve side.
(2) Measure the resistance between terminal 7 and 10.
Standard value: 2.7 - 3.4 Ω
Q: Is the resistance at the standard value?
YES : Go to Step 11.
NO : Replace the torque converter clutch solenoid valve. 
Refer to GROUP 23B, Valve Body P.23B-69.
STEP 11. Check the power supply voltage at solenoid 
valve assembly connector B-40.
(1) Disconnect connector B-40 and measure at the harness 
side.
(2) Turn the ignition switch to "ON" position.
(3) Measure the voltage between terminal 10 and ground.
• Voltage should be battery positive voltage.
(4) Turn the ignition switch to "LOCK" (OFF) position.
Q: Is the voltage normal?
YES : Go to Step 13.
NO : Go to Step 12.
